claim_boundaries.subsequent_use: Evidence handoff only for subsequent separately authorized validation. No retrospective PLAY4998, model fit, gate relaxation, activation or prospective profit claim.
claim_boundaries.core_complete_basis: 48/52 core-complete classifications are from the exact frozen03 family diagnostic, joined by drawing/event ID/order; no feature recomputation or model fit was performed in this evidence job.

feature_family_gate_review.basis: Previously accepted immutable CORE03 scope correction and its independent30-test receipt; no code changes/retests in this evidence job.
feature_family_gate_review.global_optional_gate: Requiring standings league/season or independent-opponent availability for every rolling/rest/core row would be an artificial blanket gate; corrected03 already separates those optional families.
feature_family_gate_review.core_vs_full: A2/A3 require37 complete core predictors;48/52 qualify numerically. A4/A5 allow partial observed predictors with train-only imputation/masks, but neither bypasses common entity proof.
feature_family_gate_review.common_proof_gate: Not removed or declared artificial by this job. Its current missing proof is independent of optional feature missingness.
